title: Slovakian Oven Baked Flatbread
description: A traditional Slovakian flatbread recipe, perfect for snacking or as a side dish. Baked in the oven to achieve a crispy crust.
instructions: If using homemade dough, combine warm water and salt (if using). Add to the dough and knead for 5 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Cut into desired shapes or leave as is.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
